role_summary: Lead a multi-country regional IT infrastructure operations team, owning budget, vendor governance, endpoint/VDI modernization, and disaster recovery readiness while partnering with senior stakeholders on infrastructure strategy.
must_have_requirements: 10+ years of IT infrastructure leadership experience
Experience with virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) platforms
Track record of infrastructure budget ownership
Strong stakeholder management and team leadership skills
Experience with disaster recovery program delivery
Experience leading regional/multi-country infrastructure operations teams
nice_to_have_requirements: Vendor governance and cost optimization experience
Experience in Singapore or APAC region

scoring_criteria.name: IT Infrastructure Leadership Experience (10+ yrs)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core seniority and technical leadership requirement for the role

scoring_criteria.name: Regional/Multi-Country Team Leadership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role explicitly requires leading operations across multiple countries

scoring_criteria.name: Infrastructure Budget Ownership & Vendor Governance
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Direct requirement for financial and vendor accountability

scoring_criteria.name: VDI / Endpoint Modernization Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Named technical program area central to role responsibilities

scoring_criteria.name: Disaster Recovery / Business Continuity Delivery
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Explicit requirement for DR/BCP program ownership

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder Management & Executive Partnership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role requires strategic partnership with senior stakeholders

scoring_criteria.name: Infrastructure Strategy & Planning
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role includes strategic input into infrastructure direction

scoring_criteria.name: Communication & Leadership Soft Skills
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Necessary for leading diverse regional teams and senior engagement

summary_focus: Position candidate as a senior IT infrastructure leader with multi-country team oversight
Highlight budget ownership scale and cost optimization outcomes
Emphasize VDI/endpoint modernization and DR/BCP program delivery
Showcase stakeholder engagement at senior/executive level
do_not_overclaim: Do not imply Singapore/APAC-specific experience unless explicitly stated in resume
Do not overstate DR ownership if only participated rather than led
Do not inflate team size or budget figures beyond documented resume evidence
Do not claim VDI platform expertise not explicitly named in resume

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Present candidate as a seasoned infrastructure leader capable of scaling regional operations, optimizing infrastructure spend, and delivering resilient, modern IT environments
bridge_gaps_honestly: If no direct Singapore/APAC experience, emphasize successful management of other multi-country or globally distributed teams
If DR experience is partial, frame as active contributor to DR/BCP programs while highlighting willingness to lead full ownership
If VDI experience is limited, highlight adjacent endpoint/virtualization technology experience and rapid learning capability
